reviews.title: AWESOME FOR KIDS THAT PLAY HARD!
reviews.body: Bought these for my boys who are 7 and 4. The vehicles are holding up well, some pieces have broken off which I was expecting because my kids are absolutely feral with their toys. But the BEST THING about the army men is that their arms and legs are ball joints that pop on and off. Honestly, the army men alone are absolutely worth the money just to be able to fix them so easily!

reviews.title: Fun Military Toy Set with Mixed Quality
reviews.body: Appearance:This military toy set includes a variety of vehicles, soldiers, and accessories, offering a complete setup for imaginative battles and adventures. The detail on the vehicles and figures is impressive, making it visually appealing to kids.Key Features:Comprehensive Set: Includes multiple vehicles like helicopters, boats, and ATVs, along with action figures and accessories.Imaginative Play: Perfect for kids who love role-playing and creating action-packed scenarios.Variety of Pieces: Offers plenty of options for play and customization.Pros:Great value for the number of pieces included.Encourages creativity and storytelling through pretend play.Kids will love the variety of vehicles and accessories for endless fun.Cons:The plastic quality is on the cheaper side, making the pieces feel less durable.Some parts may break with rough play or repeated use.Overall:Despite the lower-quality plastic, this toy set is a hit with kids who enjoy military-themed adventures. The variety of pieces and the fun factor make it a worthwhile purchase for the price. Highly recommended if you're looking for an affordable set to keep your child entertained.

reviews.body: The two 4 wheelers are really too big for the set but are perfect for use with 6" figures like the gijoe classified line.  The other vehicles would be decent for the 3 3/4 line.  The weapon accessories are set more in line for 6" figures too,  which make great little extras for the price.  This was one of my 6 year Olds favorite gifts this year and yes,  thick plastic so you can easily smash and bash and not be concerned about the breaking.  A very surfaceAffordable set too if you want to add to your other 6" or 3 3/4" figure vehicles and accessories for a low price.  The two figures in my pic are from the gi joe classified line,  6" figures and are not from this set.
